Subject: Sequenced rollout corridor + evaluation cadence for Novafarm (post-signature)

Hi Samira / Tom —

Great to have Novafarm across the finish line — welcome aboard. As discussed in the handoff call, we pulled together a concise "rollout corridor" that embeds the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the evaluation cadence and the canary strategy so your teams can validate incremental risk before broad migration.

Attached: Novafarm_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), canary-eval-cases.pdf (test cohort definitions).

High-level proposal (week-level):
- Week 0 (this week): final sign + contract DocuSign (Procurement looped).
- Weeks 1–2: environment provisioning (VPC peering, KMS keys), smoke tests.
- Week 3: golden-canary (1% traffic, isolated cohort), focused evaluation window (48 hours) with predefined pass/fail metrics in the eval plan.
- Weeks 4–6: phased migration (wave 1 -> 10% -> 30% -> 60%), training sweep for support engineers and product SMEs, monitoring baselines.
- Week 8: full cutover contingency date, rollback window defined.

Key asks from Novafarm:
1) Confirm primary and secondary SRE contacts for canary windows.
2) Provide two representative prompt families for the canary eval (we'll convert into automated test sets).
3) Sign the MAP spreadsheet and DocuSign by EOD Thu to meet the provisioning window.

Internal notes: Marissa — please confirm we can reserve a two-node dedicated pool for the golden-canary (region us-west-2). Laura — draft a 90-minute training slot for Week 4 for their CS and SRE teams; we should include a hands-on lab. Vivek — I'll need a short QC checklist for rollback triggers and cost guardrails.

Happy to hop on 20-minute sync if useful.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
"Making inference predictable for production"

Attachments: Novafarm_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), canary-eval-cases.pdf (pdf)
